On October 12, 2026, about 1513 central daylight time, a Monnett Sonerai 2LT airplane, N473AS, was substantially damaged when it was involved in an accident near Sextonville, Wisconsin. The pilot was seriously injured. The airplane was operated as a Title 14 Code of Federal Regulations Part 91 test flight.
The owner reported that the accident flight was the first flight of the recently completed amateur-built airplane. Shortly after takeoff, about 300 ft above ground level, a plume of black smoke was observed from the engine compartment, and the airplane lost all engine power. The airplane impacted a swamp resulting in substantial damage to the fuselage and both wings.
The airplane was retained for further examination.
